cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(hege_px4_sim)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)

# models/hege_rover/model.sdf is generated by scripts/generate_hege_model.sh
# and may not exist at build time, so the directory is installed as-is rather
# than listed file by file. PX4 reads the model straight out of the source
# tree anyway - install_to_px4.sh symlinks it into the PX4 checkout - so this
# install is for completeness, not for the SITL path to work.
install(DIRECTORY models airframes
        DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})

install(PROGRAMS
          scripts/generate_hege_model.sh
          scripts/install_to_px4.sh
        DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})

ament_package()
